items.title: Equinix shares fall on soft third-quarter forecast
items.summary: Equinix shares fell 3% on Wednesday as soft third-quarter forecast overshadowed a ‌raised full-year and long-term outlook. Here are some ‌details: • For the third quarter, Equinix expects revenue of $2.53 billion ​to $2.58 billion, the midpoint of which is below analysts' estimate of $2.58 billion. Equinix raised its forecast for 2026 revenue to a range of $10.21 to $10.29 billion, from $10.14 ‌billion to $10.24 billion.
